title: Create a project
summary: Interactively scaffold a new BornEngine project.
behavior: Prompts for the project name, 2D/2.5D/3D game type, package manager, and stable engine version. It writes the selected native profile and refuses to overwrite populated or conflicting files.

title: Create a project non-interactively
summary: Scaffold a project from a script or CI job.
behavior: Uses explicit arguments, writes the selected native profile and optional features, installs dependencies, and refuses to overwrite populated or conflicting files.

title: Initialize the current directory
summary: Scaffold BornEngine files in the current project directory.
behavior: Initializes the current directory with the selected native profile and optional features, installs dependencies, takes no project-name argument, and protects conflicting files.

title: Build a game
summary: Compile a TypeScript entry file for a target platform.
behavior: Writes build artifacts under .bornengine/builds/. Web and mobile targets are build-only; they do not run through the native run command.

title: Build and run locally
summary: Build a native executable and launch it on the current host.
options: --release selects optimized native output (default is fast/incremental)
--jobs <n> sets a positive Cargo job limit
Arguments after -- are passed to the game
behavior: Runs a native executable for the current host. Web and mobile outputs are build-only and require their platform workflow.

title: Develop with a watch loop
summary: Build during development and optionally rebuild when files change.
options: --release selects optimized native output (default is fast/incremental)
--jobs <n> sets a positive Cargo job limit
behavior: Watch mode uses .perry-dev/ for its development artifacts. Use a native target for a local executable.

title: Check a project
summary: Run Perry compatibility checks on an entry file and optionally scan installed dependencies.
options: --check-deps asks Perry to scan installed dependencies used by the entry file
--deep-deps scans the full installed dependency tree; requires --check-deps
--all includes all Perry findings, including hints
behavior: Runs Perry's compatibility check for the selected target, streams its diagnostics, and preserves its exit status. Dependency scanning is opt-in.

title: Import a Tiled map
summary: Convert an orthogonal Tiled TMX map into BornEngine World2D JSON.
options: <map-file> is a Tiled TMX file inside the project
behavior: Reads supported TMX, external TSX, tileset images, tile layers, object layers, and typed properties from project files, then writes a versioned World2D document with project-relative asset paths.

title: Validate project assets
summary: Audit asset references, signatures, and configured file or image budgets.
behavior: Uses bornengine.assets.json defaults unless an explicit CLI option overrides that value. Warnings exit 0; any error or hard validation failure exits 1.

title: Pack project assets
summary: Copy the audited inventory and write a deterministic SHA-256 manifest.
behavior: Copies exact bytes under project-relative paths and writes a sorted bornengine-assets-v1 manifest. Build and run stop before packing on hard validation failures or configured error diagnostics.

title: Clean generated artifacts
summary: Remove BornEngine-generated build and development artifacts.
behavior: Removes tracked artifacts such as .bornengine/builds/ and development output. It does not delete source files.

title: Inspect the local setup
summary: Check the tools and environment needed by BornEngine.
behavior: Reports setup checks and points to the first failing dependency. Run it before diagnosing a build failure.

title: Show project information
summary: Print the project and selected engine configuration.
behavior: Displays information useful for support reports without changing the project.

title: Print the CLI version
summary: Show the installed BornEngine CLI version.
behavior: Prints the CLI version and exits without touching project files.

title: Show the selected engine
summary: Print the engine version or path currently selected by the project.
behavior: Reads the active engine selection without changing it.

title: Select an engine release
summary: Set this project's BornEngine dependency to a stable release.
options: [version] selects a stable release; omit it to use the configured or latest release
behavior: Updates the project's BornEngine dependency and package-manager lockfile to the selected stable release.

title: List stable engine releases
summary: Show stable BornEngine versions available from the registry.
behavior: Lists stable releases available for project dependencies.

title: Update the project's engine dependency
summary: Select the latest stable engine release for the current project.
behavior: Changes the project's BornEngine dependency and lockfile to the latest stable release.

title: Remove the project engine dependency
summary: Remove BornEngine from this project's package manifest.
behavior: Removes the project's BornEngine dependency and updates the package manifest and lockfile.

title: Select an engine source
summary: Choose an installed version or a local engine path for the project.
options: <version-or-path> can identify an installed release or local path
behavior: Changes the project's BornEngine dependency to the selected release or local checkout and updates its lockfile.

title: Upgrade the project engine dependency
summary: Select a specific or latest BornEngine release for this game project.
behavior: Changes the current project's BornEngine dependency and lockfile. Use bornengine update to check for a newer CLI release.

title: Check for CLI updates
summary: Check the release channel without silently replacing the CLI.
behavior: Checks for a newer CLI release and prints the installation command. It does not self-update the binary.

title: Show the native build cache path
summary: Display the active shared Cargo target directory.
options: CARGO_TARGET_DIR selects a custom target directory
behavior: Uses the per-user BornEngine cache directory unless CARGO_TARGET_DIR is already set. It works outside a project.

title: Warm the native engine cache
summary: Build the project's selected engine and native features without compiling its TypeScript entry point.
options: --jobs <n> sets a positive Cargo job limit
behavior: Requires installed project dependencies and a supported native host. Uses the same target directory and feature profile as native project builds; it does not run Perry or launch the game.

title: Set a CLI configuration value
summary: Persist a named BornEngine CLI configuration value.
options: <value> is stored as the selected value
behavior: Writes a configuration value used by subsequent CLI operations.

title: Read a CLI configuration value
summary: Print the current value for one configuration key.
behavior: Reads one configuration key without changing it.

title: List CLI configuration
summary: Print the configuration values currently known to the CLI.
behavior: Lists configuration keys and values to make project setup easier to inspect.

title: Install Perry
summary: Download the Perry compiler for this host from a BornEngine release.
behavior: Downloads the archive for this platform, verifies its SHA-256 checksum, and extracts it into a directory for that release under the user data directory. The installed release becomes current.

title: Show the Perry compiler
summary: Print the Perry compiler that builds will run.
behavior: Prints the path from BORNENGINE_PERRY when set, otherwise the current managed install, otherwise perry from PATH.

title: List installed Perry compilers
summary: Show the Perry releases installed by bornengine perry install.
behavior: Lists managed installs and marks the current one. A perry binary found only on PATH is not listed.

title: Remove old Perry compilers
summary: Delete managed Perry installs other than the current one, plus interrupted downloads.
options: --dry-run (list what would be removed without deleting)
behavior: Keeps the current install and removes other managed releases and partial downloads. BORNENGINE_PERRY and perry on PATH are never touched.
